name: close-articulated
title: Close a door or drawer
description: Close a door, drawer or appliance door to within 0.10 rad / 4 cm of closed. A powered microwave door closes from its hinge-clearance pose, also while the robot carries a load.
use_when: A door, drawer or appliance must be closed (before heating, after taking out).

applicability.summary: Requires base_near(place=$articulated). Depending on the bound nouns, the chosen path also needs: handle_push (articulated.has_handle): hand_empty(hand=right); dispatch (always (default path)): hand_empty(hand=right).

preconditions.name: base_near
preconditions.meaning: Base centre within 1.3 m of the place's footprint (inside the room for a room).
preconditions.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

postconditions.name: is_closed
postconditions.meaning: Joint within 0.10 rad (doors) or 4 cm (drawers) of closed.
postconditions.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

verifier.how: after the policy chain, every listed predicate is evaluated on ground-truth simulator state (object poses, joint values, finger gaps, head-camera geometry, thermal state, event log); the node succeeds only if all hold for the selected path

checks.name: is_closed
checks.meaning: Joint within 0.10 rad (doors) or 4 cm (drawers) of closed.
checks.checked: after the policy chain on live GT state; the action is reported only if true

extra_preconditions.name: hand_empty
extra_preconditions.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

extra_preconditions.checked: before execution on live GT state; the Contract does not move if false

the door must be shut afterwards

next.when: a microwave or fridge must be closed before its cycle
the fridge must be closed while cooling

fallback.when: the door swing hits the base

failure.on_failure: stop; return every measured predicate, the completed policy steps and the fallback skills whose repaired predicate failed; the planner chooses what to do. Inside a multi-object node a nested call that fails a precondition with a matching repair fallback runs that repair once and retries.
